- (f) re-expressed, T90-T (f): RED. recovery.files is the ABSOLUTE box path, expected the POSIX relative form (actual ["/tmp/hgo-t90t3-<id>/.git/agent-pipeline/human-guard-overrides/audit.lock"], expected [".git/agent-pipeline/human-guard-overrides/audit.lock"]). - (g), T90-T3 (g) non-.git common dir: RED. error.recovery IS present (absolute files plus a command) for the first layout (separate-gitdir); the assertion Object.hasOwn(error, "recovery") === false fails. Other layouts (repo.git, super/.git/modules/sub) and the route-text half (two lines, no recovery line) were not reached in the RED run; the route-text half is green today by construction (the renderer rejects absolute paths) and is only exercised after F3.

- (j), T90-T3 (j) end to end: RED. The real ambiguous lock renders 2 lines, not 3 (the refusal's absolute path is rejected by the renderer's re-validation, so no third line).

4. Deliberately not changed
- Every production file; scripts/guard-human-override.test.mjs; sandbox() (other cases keep the bare temp box); the R6 comment block above the renderer pins (:4277-4280), which still describes pins that hand-build the relative form and stays true; foreign staged/dirty files (committed by exact pathspec; the commit holds exactly one file); the live .git/agent-pipeline tree (temp boxes only).

5. Deviations from spec / judgment calls
- (f) and the linked layout assert recovery.files deepEqual a ONE-element list (the briefing says "equals the POSIX relative forms ... per variant"); the old assertion was includes, so F3 may not list both lock files in one refusal.
- (h) simulates "invoked from a linked worktree path" with process.chdir into <root>/linked-wt (a real dir holding a gitdir FILE) inside try/finally, restored before cleanup. acquireAuditLock(paths) takes no cwd, so this only pins that F3 must not derive the form from the invocation directory; it is process-global state, named for the Critic.
- The wording pin uses the briefing's plain spelling "run from the main checkout root (the directory that holds .git)"; Ruling 136 line 1843 renders .git in backticks.
- gitSandbox paths carry base (mirrors storage()); the older sandbox() boxes carry only auditLock and auditLockRecovery. F3 must therefore either derive from the lock path or tolerate a missing base.
- Not read: CONT15 header (briefing said nothing else from the briefing folder), the Opus T90 critic notes.

- Closing handover (structured). Committed: a7fb4f76d (test file only).
